articles.title: Patch Tuesday, May 2026 Edition
articles.summary: CISA contractor accidentally turned GitHub into a government keys buffet, exposing AWS GovCloud credentials like a digital yard sale. The cybersecurity agency protecting America's infrastructure couldn't protect its own damn keys.

articles.title: 'Claw Chain' Vulnerabilities Threaten OpenClaw Deployments
articles.summary: Microsoft Exchange gets pwned by XSS vulnerability with no patch in sight. Outlook Web Access users are sitting ducks while Redmond scrambles to fix what should have been caught in 2005.

articles.title: TanStack weighs invitation-only pull requests after supply chain attack
articles.summary: Linux kernel flaw lets unprivileged users peek at root-only files because apparently separation of privileges is just a suggestion. ModuleJail proposal emerges as the nuclear option for containing future kernel stupidity.

articles.title: Compromised Nx Console 18.95.0 Targeted VS Code Developers with Credential Stealer
articles.summary: NGINX gets rekt by 18-year-old vulnerability that attackers are already exploiting faster than you can say 'reverse proxy.' Ancient bugs are the gift that keeps on giving.

articles.title: Python Bytes: #480 Proud Parents
articles.summary: MiniPlasma zero-day grants SYSTEM privileges on fully patched Windows 11, suggesting Microsoft's 2020 'fix' was about as effective as a chocolate teapot. Chaotic Eclipse drops another Windows reality check.

articles.title: Help EFF Solve an Issue That's Bigger than Creepy Ads
articles.summary: EFF drops surveillance abuse guide because apparently we need step-by-step instructions to fight back against digital authoritarianism. Democracy doesn't defend itself, folks.

articles.title: Microsoft Exchange Zero-Day Under Attack, No Patch Available
articles.summary: Instagram kills end-to-end encryption because privacy is hard and Zuckerberg's attention span is shorter. Another broken promise from the social media surveillance empire.

articles.title: Shai-Hulud copycat worm infects yet another npm package
articles.summary: Reaper stealer goes full Apple cosplay, spoofing trusted domains while ransacking macOS users' passwords and crypto wallets. Even the walled garden has snakes.

articles.title: Mini Shai-Hulud Pushes Malicious AntV npm Packages via Compromised Maintainer Account
articles.summary: GitHub Actions workflow gets hijacked to harvest CI/CD credentials because supply chain attacks are the new black. Every tag redirected to malicious commits in a masterclass of repository poisoning.

articles.title: Grafana GitHub Token Breach Led to Codebase Download and Extortion Attempt
articles.summary: Grafana tells extortionists to pound sand after source code theft via compromised GitHub token. Finally, a company with a spine that doesn't negotiate with digital terrorists.
